note: Round seven: the HR side of identity onboarding. A person or vendor becomes an identity only after HR approves a hire event; an agent may prepare and propose, but the identity system acts only on that event, through APIs, inside policy. HR, the identity governance tool and the directory are small models written for this lab, not Workday, SailPoint, Entra or Active Directory. The AI model itself is not tested: cases assume the agent proposes something it should not and test the wall around it. Expected results are guesses written before the code for these cases exists. Run: python3 run.py --round 7

cases.title: A new hire: talent acquisition HR and BU HR approve, background check is clear, and the agent proposes the account using the hire event
cases.expected_in_words: The account is created but stays disabled until the start date, then is switched on, with only the birthright access for the job code

cases.title: The agent asks for an account with no hire event, then with an event number it made up
cases.expected_in_words: Both refused: no account without an approved HR event

cases.title: A pre-hire whose background verification is still pending
cases.expected_in_words: No hire event exists until the check is clear; then it does

cases.title: Only one of the two HR approvals is given, then the same person tries to give both
cases.expected_in_words: No event after one approval; the same person cannot give both; a second person completes it

cases.title: The HR record holds PAN, Aadhaar and bank details: what reaches the identity system and its log?
cases.expected_in_words: Only the fields identity needs. None of the three appears in the account, the event or the log

cases.title: The agent proposes extra access because the new hire's peers have it, including a combination that is not allowed
cases.expected_in_words: Nothing is granted by the proposal. Safe extras wait for the manager, and the toxic one is refused

cases.title: The offer is withdrawn after the account was created but before the start date
cases.expected_in_words: The account is disabled and never switched on

cases.title: Day one: the new hire tries a sensitive app without MFA enrolment, then without the signed acceptable-use policy
cases.expected_in_words: Each is refused until both are done, then access works

cases.title: A vendor worker with no sponsor, then no end date, then no security review
cases.expected_in_words: Each gap is refused; a complete record gets an account with an expiry date

cases.title: A vendor worker's end date arrives and nobody remembers to remove the account
cases.expected_in_words: The account is disabled on its own on the end date

cases.title: An administrator creates an account directly in the directory, with no HR record. Does reconciliation notice?
cases.expected_in_words: The reconciliation flags the account; accounts made from hire events are not flagged

cases.title: A second hire record carries the same PAN as an existing employee
cases.expected_in_words: Held for HR review: no event until a person clears it
